name: 현우
visual_review: 붉은 머리·강한 눈매·글러브와 교복풍 복장을 유지했습니다. 당김·충전·단 한 번의 직선 핵펀치·팔로스루·회수의 포즈 차이가 분명합니다.
motion_summary: Hyunwoo red spiky hair, intense red/dark eyes, white jacket over black-red shirt, red combat gloves from portrait. Official R charges then delivers one extremely strong punch knocking targets back. Animate boxing idle; drawing right fist back; lowering knees; twisting hips backward; fist glows orange-red; maximum wind-up with arm at rear and weight on rear leg; explosive straight punch forward right; full extension with compact white-orange angular shockwave cone; torso follow-through with front knee bent; retract fist; stand to boxing stance; original idle. Only ONE charged punch, not repeated attacks or uppercut. Maintain recognizable face, eyes and small gritted mouth, arms correctly connected.
